appDescription: ChargeCheck tells EV drivers which public chargers actually work, using real charging results recorded by cars, and lets them report charger problems by voice.

function.name: CHECK_CHARGERS
function.description: Find reliable EV charging stations near the car, along the route to the navigation destination, or check the destination charger, using recent real charging results.

scope.description: Where to look: along the route to the current destination, near the car, or the destination charger itself.

min_kw.description: Minimum charging power in kW the user asked for. Use 0 if not mentioned.

free_parking.description: True if the user wants stations with free parking only.

connector.description: Connector type the user asked for, or any.

function.name: ADD_CHARGER_STOP
function.description: Add the recommended reliable charging station as a waypoint in the car navigation, usually the one just suggested.

scope.description: Pick the stop along the route or near the car.

function.name: REPORT_CHARGER_PROBLEM
function.description: Record a problem with the charger at the station where the car is now, so other drivers are warned.

problem.description: What went wrong: not charging, broken charger, payment failed, blocked by a parked non-EV car, cable too short, charging too slow, or other.

charger_number.description: Charger number written on the charger if the user said it, for example 3. Empty if not mentioned.
